BIND_ADDRESS.DESCRIPTION: IP address the bridge listens on, 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces

LINK_BUTTON.NAME: Press link button
LINK_BUTTON.DESCRIPTION: Accept new Hue apps and voice assistants for 3 minutes. Start the device search in the app while the window is open.

REMOVE_USERS.NAME: Remove all users
REMOVE_USERS.DESCRIPTION: Removes all paired Hue apps and voice assistants. They have to be paired again with the link button.
